title: High Society
description: The Emberlyn Sapphire has passed down Lady Emberlyn's line for four generations and it will be on display, unguarded by anything but the crowd, at her masquerade ball. Vex wants it in Guild hands - not for the gold, for the name it makes for whoever pulls it off. Get in, take it, and get out without a face anyone remembers.

objectives.description: Get an invitation, however you can manage it
Blend in among the masked guests
Find where the sapphire's on display
Talk your way past a guest who's noticed you
objectives.notes: The challenge.skill_checks phase "if_questioned", made real. Optional, so a failed lie never strands the heist.

objectives.description: Lift the sapphire without a hand seeing it move
Get out of Thornfield before your face is known

challenge.description: Must blend in with nobles, avoid suspicion, time the theft perfectly
challenge.detection_consequences: Identified as thief, bounty placed, quest failure

optional_objectives.description: Replace sapphire with fake before it's noticed (buys more time)
Steal from other guests while at party

notes: High-stakes social stealth mission. Multiple skill checks. Emberlyn Estate in Thornfield. Rewards Shadow Cloak (stealth bonus item). Threat: a four-generation family heirloom, taken for reputation rather than need. Giver motive: Vex wants the Guild's name made, not the gold. Consequence: unwired beyond quest failure on detection - no flag records the Emberlyn family's response or whether Lady Emberlyn becomes a standing enemy of the Guild (flags_set includes thieves_emberlyn_enemy, which nothing currently reads).
